tagline: AI argues. Code verifies what can execute.
hackathon: Tencent Cloud AI CAN DO IT Hackathon Singapore 2026
differentiation: Facts are computed by code from platform, user and external records; the policy is a public, numbered, sourced document that runs as code; the agents may only cite both; a pre-execution policy check decides what may execute. Money can be automatic, account punishment never is.
agents: Judge (no tools, rules only on open questions)

data.nature: synthetic trips on real OneMap road geometry; GPS traces simulated; no real rider or driver

metrics.name: exact core decision, one model call
metrics.comparator: 27/49 (55.1%) with a raw case record, GPS thinned to 30 s
metrics.scope: same DeepSeek model, one call each, 49 synthetic cases
metrics.limitations: measures the value of code-computed facts, not a contribution attributable to any one agent

metrics.name: wrong core decisions that would execute
metrics.comparator: 21/49 for a raw single call with no execution check
metrics.scope: full court with the pre-execution policy check; 49 cases plus repeat runs

metrics.name: full court match to the policy-derived reference core decision
metrics.scope: outcome, amount to the cent, escalation
metrics.limitations: policy conformance, not production accuracy; reference answers derived from the written policy, no blind human labelling yet

metrics.name: prototype routing
metrics.value: 41 auto-cleared, 8 to a person, 5 account flags to a person
metrics.scope: eligibility decided by code after the ruling

metrics.name: invalid citations
metrics.comparator: raw call: 4 of 206, 3 invented fact ids

metrics.name: same ruling on repeat
metrics.scope: 2 runs of every case, full court

metrics.name: latency and cost
metrics.value: 23.9 s mean, p95 33.8 s, 6 model calls, about 92k input tokens per case

real: working API, UI and SSE event stream
sourced policy clauses with disclosed gaps
synthetic_or_simulated: traffic, congestion and weather values per scenario

live_runs: off on the public site; `Run live` works on a local copy with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY set (README, Run it)

evidence.claim: policy as code: allowed outcomes and amount formula

codebuddy_evidence: conversation screenshots and a development reflection attached to the submission
